steps.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
procedure_descriptions: [FrostyGoop Incident](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0041) was likely enabled by the adversary exploiting an unknown vulnerability in an external-facing router.(Citation: Dragos FROSTYGOOP 2024)

steps.name: Web Shell
procedure_descriptions: [FrostyGoop Incident](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0041) deployed a ReGeorg variant web shell to impacted systems following initial access for persistence.(Citation: Dragos FROSTYGOOP 2024)

steps.name: Downgrade Attack
procedure_descriptions: During [FrostyGoop Incident](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0041), the adversary downgraded firmware on victim devices in order to impair visibility into the process environment.(Citation: Dragos FROSTYGOOP 2024)

steps.name: Security Account Manager
procedure_descriptions: During [FrostyGoop Incident](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0041), the adversary retrieved the contents of the Security Account Manager (SAM) hive in the victim environment for credential capture.(Citation: Dragos FROSTYGOOP 2024)

steps.name: Application Layer Protocol
procedure_descriptions: During [FrostyGoop Incident](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0041), the adversary initiated Layer Two Tunnelling Protocol (L2TP) connections to Moscow-based IP addresses.(Citation: Dragos FROSTYGOOP 2024)
